names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/9516.html` link carries in its `title` and as that page's heading, «Виктор (Каракулин), иерей, сщмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off; the surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays. The day's own line gives only «Сщмч. Виктора (1937).» `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write; the corpus's `victor-yavorsky`, who stands on this same menologion day, is a different surname and a different man.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст.: «Сщмч. Виктора (1937).» His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Виктора (1937).»

attestations.note: **The line is all there is**, and it is the shortest on the day: a rank, a forename and a year, with the surname only in the name link. Name page 9516 is a heading, the grade and two days, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 19 мая», and nothing else. The 26 января is the synaxis of the new martyrs, a company's feast and not a second day of his own. **He is not `victor-yavorsky`**, whom the corpus already keeps on this menologion day: a different surname, and nothing read links them. azbyka.ru was not read.
